steps.title: Initialize Project Structure for Study Planner Pro
steps.description: Establish directories and files structure for the Study Planner Pro Android app.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Files
steps.description: Apply AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, target SDK 34, and set compile targets to Java 8.

steps.title: Design Application Manifest
steps.description: Setup AndroidManifest.xml with system services, alarm scheduling, local notifications, and specify MainActivity.

steps.title: Implement Color and String Resource Schemes
steps.description: Define the visual color scheme (bg_main, text_primary, text_secondary, color_primary, etc.) and application titles.

steps.title: Create Modern Card and Button Backgrounds
steps.description: Design visual state rounded drawables for buttons, fields and layout containers using custom vectors.

steps.title: Build Main Activity User Interface Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml consisting of dynamic Tab screens (Dashboard, Subjects list, Tasks list, Study timer).

steps.title: Create Subject List Row Layout
steps.description: Formulate item_subject.xml with customizable visual indicators and clear deletion actions.

steps.title: Create Task List Row Layout
steps.description: Design item_task.xml holding status checks, priority tags, date labels, and title description fields.

steps.title: Design Subject Addition Dialog
steps.description: Construct dialog_add_subject.xml with subject title forms and customizable color schemes.

steps.title: Design Task Addition Dialog
steps.description: Construct dialog_add_task.xml with text inputs, relative selectors, and scheduling switches.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Study Database Manager
steps.description: Develop DatabaseHelper.java to manage tables for Subjects, Tasks and logged study intervals.

steps.title: Develop Alarm Notification Broadcast Receiver
steps.description: Create ReminderReceiver.java to capture alarm schedules and launch user background notifications.

steps.title: Implement Study Focus Timer and Multi-Tab Navigation
steps.description: Complete MainActivity.java with interactive focus clocks, stats summaries, and state-retaining list adapters.

steps.title: Building Study Planner Pro
steps.description: Launch exact Gradle build routines to package and test the complete Study Planner Pro application.
